# Park JiHo | AI & Robotics Research Notes

> A personal technical site for AI, robotics, computer vision, machine vision, human-robot interaction, research engineering, and implementation notes by Park JiHo.

Agents should start with this file, use the sitemap for exhaustive URL discovery, and fetch the canonical page that best matches the task. The site is read-only: it publishes research notes and project context rather than an agent API. Prefer the Writing archive for detailed technical explanations, Research for topic-level orientation, and About for author/background context. A Markdown representation of the homepage is available at https://jjo-0.github.io/index.md for clients that follow alternate Markdown links.

## When to use this site

- [Research world](https://jjo-0.github.io/research): Use when the task needs Park JiHo's public research focus across robotics, AI, vision, human-robot interaction, safety, or system integration.
- [Writing archive](https://jjo-0.github.io/posts): Use when the task needs technical notes, study material, implementation details, derivations, experiments, or long-form explanations.
- [About](https://jjo-0.github.io/about): Use when the task needs public author background, affiliations, skills, or education context.
- [Homepage Markdown](https://jjo-0.github.io/index.md): Use when a Markdown-first client needs a compact, low-noise representation of the homepage and its primary navigation.

## How to retrieve content

- [Homepage](https://jjo-0.github.io/): Fetch with HTTP GET for the canonical HTML homepage; meaningful headings and text are present in the raw response without requiring JavaScript.
- [Sitemap index](https://jjo-0.github.io/sitemap-index.xml): Use for exhaustive discovery of public canonical pages instead of guessing paths.
- [RSS feed](https://jjo-0.github.io/rss.xml): Use for chronological discovery of published writing and recent updates.
- [Robots policy](https://jjo-0.github.io/robots.txt): Check before large-scale crawling.

## Best-fit topics

- [Research](https://jjo-0.github.io/research): Robotics systems, machine/computer vision, perception, human-robot interaction, safety, learning, and research-system integration.
- [Writing](https://jjo-0.github.io/posts): AI foundations, modern AI, robotics, vision, development, research methods, engineering notes, and selected industry/finance analysis.

## Optional

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/JJo-0): Use when source repositories or public implementation artifacts are more relevant than the prose on this site.
